fact: The Ministry of Finance says the Secrétaire d'État aux Finances et au Budget presided over the handover, under the World Bank-supported PATN, of equipment to the 23 communes that are provincial capitals, including Starlink Business kits with antenna, router and Wi-Fi, monthly internet subscriptions from a service provider and Wi-Fi access points; the post itself carries no date, and the ceremony is dated 19 May 2026 by the press.
title: Remise d’équipements aux 23 communes : le numérique au service des citoyens
publisher: Ministère des Finances, du Budget, de l’Économie, du Plan et de la Coopération Internationale- TCHAD
